_comment: Known encoding profiles. Values come from each model card's official
Getting a prefix wrong produces no error and no warning — it only lowers
quality, which is the hardest kind of failure to attribute. That is why
this table exists, and why an adapter refuses to load when its profile
fingerprint does not match rather than degrading quietly.
A user can extend this file, or pass --profile on the command line.
`matryoshka_dim` records that a model's own card documents Matryoshka
Representation Learning — that truncating its vectors is an operation the
model was trained for rather than one performed on it. It is set from the
card and from nowhere else: a model whose card is silent gets no entry, and
`probe --truncate` measures such a model rather than assuming either way.
Two carry it today: nomic-embed-text-v1.5 and mxbai-embed-large-v1, whose
card states it supports both MRL and quantization.
